context: Asuka and Sakura reflect on a year of study.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: study reflection; vocabulary (去年/かける/させる/正しく/伴う) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 去年より、ずいぶん成長しましたね。
lines.en: You've grown a lot since last year.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured encouraging clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 去年は、基礎に時間をかけました。
lines.en: Last year I spent time on the basics.
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 正しく理解しようと、努力しましたね。
lines.en: You made an effort to understand correctly.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 理解には、復習が伴いますね。
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 体に覚えさせるのが、大切です。
lines.en: Making it stick to the body matters.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 繰り返して、覚えさせました。
lines.en: By repeating, I made it stick.
lines.style: engaged adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 時間をかければ、必ず実ります。
lines.en: If you put in time, it always bears fruit.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured encouraging clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 去年の自分を、超えたいです。
lines.en: I want to surpass last year's self.
lines.style: motivated adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
